g.text: Probe - the forward walk over one region
One per non-speech region, plus the promotable
silences and the region's own start. A prober
"every piece of per-region probe state starts
fresh" structural rather than a reset somebody
highlight the region on the progress bar
Window end is planned so the decode does not
run into Whisper's 30 s chunk: a window at or
past it silently drops a one-word announcement.
a descending skim already read this window?
Same candidate, same arithmetic, so the
transcript is the one this decode would
produce. The re-reads a fruitless window
a number heard without its word?
if this file has earned one
jingle speech nothing was heard in?
re-read the music, or its speech
The scope, duplicate and drop rules live in one
ledger shared with Scan, which searches the
stretches it reads in full. Two copies of "is
this in scope, is it a duplicate" would be two
answers, and the ledger is also what stops both
apply the marks to the running sequence
a gap opened in the numbering?
skip the candidates this window settled
a restart still being tracked when the
region runs out is booked as lost
A number that could not be
corroborated may not displace a floor something
else confirmed - though it still sets one where
Both halves are load-bearing. Without the first,
a misheard number becomes the floor, the real
chapters after it read as below the sequence,
three of them confirm a part restart, and both
later repairs then see two strictly ascending
sequences and nothing wrong - the split protects
the mishearing that caused it. Without the
second, a book whose first chapter is itself
uncorroborated has no floor at all.
